A weakened immune system can lead to frequent infections, chronic illnesses, and slower recovery from illnesses. Salvia mellifera plant may help bolster immune function by providing antioxidants and anti-inflammatory compounds that enhance the body's natural defenses.

The alkaloids in Salvia mellifera may stimulate the production of immune cells, while flavonoids contribute to the modulation of immune responses. Additionally, these phytochemicals may enhance the activity of natural killer cells and T-cells, which are crucial for immune function. Overall, the synergistic effects of these bioactive compounds make Salvia mellifera a valuable natural support for immune health.
benefits.study: According to "Phytotherapy research : PTR", Salvia mellifera is among the botanicals with documented immunomodulatory, immunostimulatory, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can support the immune system.
